bjj-gis.name: BJJ Uniforms
bjj-gis.intro: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu gis in pearl, gold and all-play weaves from 280 to 400 GSM, with ripstop pants. Made to order in your colours with your academy branding.

judo-uniforms.name: Judo Uniforms
judo-uniforms.intro: Judo gis in three weights: 450 GSM Academy, 550 GSM Challenger and 700 GSM Winner, with 100% cotton drill pants.

karate-uniforms.name: Karate Uniforms
karate-uniforms.intro: 10 oz karate uniforms in poly-cotton or 100% cotton, in all regular colours, with elastic or drawstring waist.

taekwondo-uniforms.name: Taekwondo Uniforms
taekwondo-uniforms.intro: Taekwondo doboks in poly-cotton or 100% cotton, in all regular colours, with elastic waist pants.

sambo-uniforms.name: Sambo Uniforms
sambo-uniforms.intro: Sambo jackets and shorts made to order in red and blue.

belts.name: BJJ Belts
belts.intro: BJJ and judo rank belts, 350 GSM gi-fabric belts and casual belts, in every rank colour and in sizes S to 3XL.

mma-shorts.name: MMA Shorts
mma-shorts.intro: Fully sublimated MMA and grappling shorts in stretch polyester, printed with your designs and team colours.

rash-guards.name: Rash Guards
rash-guards.intro: Short and long sleeve rash guards in compression fabric, sublimated with your designs and rank colours.

fight-wear.name: Fight Wear
fight-wear.intro: Hoodies and wrestling singlets for teams and academies, made with your colours and branding.

bags.name: Gi Bags
bags.intro: Gi backpacks with room for uniform, belt and gear, branded for your academy.

FactoryPage.metaDescription: Ten in-house departments, from fabric making and dyeing to stitching and packing. See how Spotex makes martial arts uniforms.
FactoryPage.intro: Most uniform suppliers buy fabric and outsource stitching. We do every step ourselves in Gujranwala, Pakistan, so we control quality, colour and delivery time.
FactoryPage.quality: Our R&D and apparel testing lab checks materials and finished products before they ship. Spotex is ISO 9001:2015 certified.

AboutPage.metaDescription: A martial arts uniform manufacturer in Gujranwala, Pakistan, making gis and belts since 1989.
AboutPage.intro: Spotex International started as a small workshop in Gujranwala, Pakistan. Today we make martial arts uniforms, belts and fight wear for academies, clubs and brands abroad, with every step of production under our own roof.
